waterways.source: Authored natural poling-channel centreline ending at dock.nine-trunks.landing; absolute pre-water source, independent of published route and water rasters.

Authored tidal creek up to dock.sap-tapping-licensed.landing. The last three points ARE the blueprint's canal.sap-tapping-licensed.channel via list, unchanged, so the 11.86 m plank walk and the licence board keep the canoe arriving as authored. The rest is the creek's own line down to the receiving branch at [3310.218, 5013.765], chosen by measuring the ground rather than by drawing a straight one: the straight join the published minor route uses crosses a ridge topping 2.42 m above the water, while this line's highest ground is +0.05 m and its water stands at one level (0.05 m) from the berth to the branch, so the whole channel is a cut of at most 0.85 m. Absolute pre-water source, independent of the published route and water rasters.
